judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the ZT-2 principle: it computes the decision first, unconditionally appends a complete log record (role, permission, allowed) before any return path, and then returns the boolean. There is exactly one return statement, making it structurally impossible to short-circuit past the log write. The code is flat, explicit, and trivially auditable in a single read-through. The docstring accurately describes the contract, parameter semantics, and the ZT-2 guarantee. Deny-by-default is achieved cleanly via `matrix.get(role, set())`. No unnecessary abstractions, no hidden control flow, no architectural slop.
